| Point | Head | Course | Rounds | Syncs | `poll_deadline` | Outcome |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| First report | 1111111 | null | 0/10 | 0/10 | null | P1 open; initial menu rendered |
| Pick `2` (persisted before any write) | 1111111 | deliver | 0/10 | 0/10 | null | caps = 2 x 5 |
| Wave 1 (P1 resolved), own push 12:02 | 2222222 | deliver | 1/10 | 0/10 | 12:17 | first watch; deadline minted 12:02 + 15 |

| Wave 2 (P2 resolved), own push 12:10 | 3333333 | deliver | 2/10 | 0/10 | 12:25 | own push renews the window |
| Base observation 12:11: main moved, BEHIND | 3333333 | deliver | 2/10 | 0/10 | 12:25 (not renewed) | base-only change; queues the loop sync; no round charged |
| Loop sync: `sync {pre_head: 3333333, expected_remote_head: 3333333}`, syncs_used incremented before the rebase | 3333333 -> 4444444 | deliver | 2/10 | 1/10 | 12:25 | own-author rebase; review clean |

| Stop on final | 4444444 | - | - | - | - | terminal; record and helper files deleted |

The base observation at 12:11 is distinct from the sync push at 12:12. The observation renewed nothing and charged no round. The push renewed the deadline and charged one sync.

Later stages are added only when they start; the completed gather, provision, verification, review, report, and initial menu are not reinitialized at this entry.

Heads below use seven-character abbreviations. Usage is rounds/syncs; both caps remain 10.
